summary: Frontend-only validation of the bug fix that pre-loads MaterialCommunityIcons alongside Ionicons at app boot via useIconFonts() so the scale-balance FAIDE tab icon no longer pops in late on slow connections. Verified: (1) app boots without crash/red-screen, (2) both Ionicons.ttf AND MaterialCommunityIcons.ttf are requested in parallel at boot (t=2ms and t=4ms respectively — Delta 2ms — even under CDP-throttled slow-3G), (3) SplashScreen.hideAsync fires only after both fonts resolve (useFonts blocking + `if (!loaded && !error) return null;` gate in _layout.tsx), (4) after anonymous login + T&C acceptance, the bottom tab bar renders 5 icons L→R with the MCI scale-balance glyph (U+F05D1) at the leftmost position, same visual weight (30px vs 25px * 1.18 scale = 29.5px≈30px) and same active brand color rgb(255,59,48) as the Ionicons siblings (bookmark U+F1A8, chatbubbles U+F217, notifications U+F475, person U+F4A5). document.fonts registry confirms both `ionicons` and `material-community` reach status `loaded`. No regressions on other Ionicons; anonymous person-add tab correctly hidden. No React Native deprecated-package issues detected in the touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: use-icon-fonts.ts:60-61 casts Ionicons.font/MaterialCommunityIcons.font to Record<string, any> — pragmatic TS workaround, acceptable but a proper type from @expo/vector-icons would be cleaner.

Boot fires 4 font network requests (2x Ionicons + 2x MCI) because both the injected @font-face stylesheet and useFonts() trigger fetches. Browser dedupes so it's harmless, but if wanting to be strict, using only useFonts (skip @font-face injection) or only stylesheet would halve the request count.

Pre-verified chat_a@test.it / test123 credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md returned 400 'Email o password sbagliata' — these accounts appear NOT to exist in the current DB. Not related to this fix, but worth flagging for future test iterations. Used anonymous signup as workaround.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The fix modifies /app/frontend/src/hooks/use-icon-fonts.ts to add Ionicons.font + MaterialCommunityIcons.font to useFonts() so the tab-bar scale-balance icon paints atomically with the other icons at cold start. To reproduce end-to-end use: anonymous signup (chat_a@test.it seeded creds are broken — 400 on login). Login flow: home → ANONIMO tab → fill Nickname → ENTRA COME ANONIMO → T&C page (must scroll terms-scroll to bottom to enable terms-accept-btn) → tabs. On slow-3G (CDP throttling: latency=400ms, downloadThroughput=50KB/s) both font requests still fire at t≈2-4ms confirming the pre-load is unconditional.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: bottom tab bar's FAIDE icon (MaterialCommunityIcons 'scale-balance') was painting later than the other 4 Ionicons tabs on slow web connections, causing a visible FOUC where the first tab slot appeared empty then popped in. Root cause: only Ionicons was hot on the network because it was used across the app UI, while MCI was only referenced by that one glyph — browser lazily fetched MaterialCommunityIcons.ttf on first render of the scale-balance codepoint. Fix: useIconFonts() now explicitly declares both Ionicons.font and MaterialCommunityIcons.font in the useFonts() call, so expo-font blocks the splash until BOTH are ready. Verified in preview: throttled boot shows Ionicons and MCI requests fired 2ms apart at cold start (before any UI paints), and normal-network render shows all 5 tab icons L→R simultaneously with the MCI glyph at leftmost.
